title: Source License Trust Gate: OA status and publisher policies stop counting as proof

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.117 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.117 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow source-license trust release; focused source-ledger tests plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on a fresh deployed v0.15.116 ZIP/log audit that regrades at 98/A under the stricter local rule. A fresh deployed v0.15.117 audit is still required before claiming clean provider output.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.116 UX audit looked clean in the app, but stricter local source audit regraded it at 98/A because three sourceLedger rows carried ambiguous license proof.
proofCommands: rg -n "Local regrade after this stricter gate:|98/100|sf2|sf-1-2|sf-8-2" docs/V0.15.117_SOURCE_LICENSE_TRUST_GATE_ROADMAP.md

claims.summary: Production source-ledger assembly treats other-oa, publisher TDM URLs, and publisher policy URLs as ambiguous license proof.
The local deep source-ledger grader flags existing packages that trusted other-oa, TDM, or publisher-policy license proof.
Focused source-ledger regressions no longer enforce the old behavior where publisher TDM URLs were treated as license-safe proof.
The release explicitly carries forward fresh deployed v0.15.117 provider verification instead of claiming clean output from a local trust-gate patch.

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.117 ZIP/log audit must prove no other-oa, TDM, or publisher-policy license row is trusted sourceLedger proof.
Fresh deployed output must prove Texture reaches 100/100 or identify the next concrete repeated shingle.
Every exported surface must agree: UI, ZIP, manifest, quality report, source report, digest logs, DOCX/PPTX files, and local regrade.
